visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) Three identical male figures dressed in long black wigs and white sailor-style schoolgirl uniforms with short black skirts stand against a dark background illuminated by purple neon triangle shapes. They face the camera directly, holding their hands in OK gestures. The central figure is the focal point, with cloned versions on each side performing the same movements. Yellow subtitles are positioned at the lower center, while variety text and logos appear in the upper corners. (2) The characters transition their hand positions to wave their open palms near their faces while maintaining broad, enthusiastic smiles. Their exposed midriffs are visible due to the cropped style of the sailor tops. The background neon pulses rhythmically. (3) The figures move into a synchronized shouting pose, cupping their hands around their mouths as if calling out. Their mouths are wide open in a loud vocalization. (4) They execute a coordinated dance move, leaning sideways while placing their hands on their knees and lifting one foot off the ground. The lighting remains bright and consistent across all three figures. (5) The characters flex their right biceps while pointing their left hands toward their heads in a confident, stylized pose. (6) They perform a rhythmic circular motion with their hands at waist level, mimicking a rowing or cranking action. (7) The figures clasp their hands together in a heart or prayer-like gesture in front of their chests, nodding in time. (8) All three figures jump vertically in unison, keeping their schoolgirl skirts fluttering. (9) They perform another bicep flex followed by a pointing gesture towards the viewer. (10) The sequence concludes with the characters waving both hands energetically towards the camera, followed by a final pointing gesture diagonally downwards to the side as the video ends.
